privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Your privacy matters. This Privacy Policy explains how FitForce collects, uses, and protects your data.

informationWeCollect.heading: Information We Collect
items: Client data entered by coaches (managed securely)
Usage data to improve platform performance

dataProtection.heading: Data Protection
items: Client data belongs to the coach — FitForce does not sell or share it
Access to data is restricted and monitored

thirdPartyServices.heading: Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.body: FitForce may use trusted third-party services (payment gateways, analytics tools) strictly to operate the platform.

yourRights.heading: Your Rights
items: Request correction or deletion of your data
Cancel your account at any time

contactUs.heading: Contact Us
contactUs.body: For privacy-related questions, contact us at:

deleteAccount.title: Delete Your Account
deleteAccount.intro: You can request deletion of your FitForce account and all associated data at any time.

howToRequest.heading: How to Request Deletion
howToRequest.body: Send an email to support@fitforce.app from your registered email address with the subject "Account Deletion Request", including your full name and the email associated with your account.

whatGetsDeleted.heading: What Gets Deleted
whatGetsDeleted.intro: Once your request is processed, we will delete:
items: Your profile information (name, email, phone number)
Training and nutrition plans, and check-in forms
Messages and attachments exchanged with your coach

whatIsRetained.heading: What Is Retained
whatIsRetained.body: Billing and transaction records are retained as required for legal, tax, and accounting purposes, even after your account is deleted.

timeframe.heading: Processing Time
timeframe.body: Deletion requests are processed within 30 days of receipt.

contactUs.heading: Contact
contactUs.body: For questions about this process, contact us at:
